analysis.title: Thomson Reuters Corp. (TRI): 3Q First Take: Revenue and EBITDA outperform as organic growth outlook raised post Global Print divestiture
key_insights: GS expects a positive investor reaction to TRI's 3Q 2026 print: revenue and adjusted EBITDA beat consensus, and full-year organic revenue growth guidance was raised, partly offset by a small EPS miss versus consensus.

3Q revenue was $1,833mn, up 10.6% y/y, versus the GS estimate of 8.7% growth and FactSet consensus of 10.1%. Organic revenue grew 10% y/y versus the GS forecast of 8.9%, an acceleration from 9% in 2Q.

Big 3 organic revenue grew 10% y/y, above the GS estimate of 9.5% and consistent with 2Q. The Big 3 are 87% of total revenue. Corporates and Tax, Audit & Accounting each grew 10% organically, and Legal grew 9%.
Legal organic growth slowed to 9% from 10% in 2Q, driven by recurring revenue in Westlaw and CoCounsel plus higher transactions revenue from CLEAR.

Tax, Audit & Accounting organic growth accelerated to 10% from 8.0% in 2Q, driven by recurring revenue in GoSystem, CoCounsel, Cloud Audit Suite and the Latin America business, plus transactions growth in SafeSend, SurePrep and Additive.
Corporates organic growth was 10%, consistent with 2Q, driven by recurring revenue in CoCounsel Legal, Pagero, CLEAR and international businesses.
Adjusted EBITDA margin fell 30 bps y/y to 35.5% on higher investment in Legal. That beat the GS forecast of 34.6% and matched consensus.
3Q EPS of $0.81 beat the GS estimate of $0.77 and slightly missed FactSet consensus of $0.83.

FY2026 guidance: reported revenue growth raised from ~8.0% to ~9.5% and total organic growth raised from ~8% to 8.5-9.0%. Big 3 organic growth is unchanged at 9.5-10.0%. The company says the organic raise is due to the Global Print divestiture.
FY2026 EBITDA margin guidance was cut from ~40%+ to ~39% because of the Global Print divestiture. Expected margin expansion is unchanged at 100 bps and FCF is unchanged at ~$2.1bn.

GS says guidance implies lower consensus revenue estimates and stable consensus EBITDA margins. Pre-print GS forecast was 9.6% reported revenue growth (8.9% organic) and 39.2% EBITDA margin, versus FactSet consensus of 12.4% reported growth and 39.3% margin.
4Q 2026 guidance: organic revenue growth of ~8% and EBITDA margin of ~42%.
Management said customer engagement with the next generation of CoCounsel Legal has been encouraging, and it recently launched the next generation of CoCounsel Tax, Audit & Accounting.

GS expects the earnings call to focus on the financial impact of the Global Print divestiture, Legal growth in 4Q and 2027, AI-driven competitive changes, AI monetization plans and cost efficiency initiatives.

GS rates TRI Buy with a $125 12-month price target (24.5x NTM+1YR EPS of $5.11), 2.3% above the $122.24 close on 2 Nov 2026. The multiple sits above the 17.5x median Info Services NTM P/E, which GS attributes to resilient growth, a wide moat and a record of execution.

market_movers.rationale: Revenue and EBITDA beat and organic growth guidance was raised. The 12-month target is based on 24.5x NTM+1YR EPS of $5.11, with 2.3% upside from $122.24.

earnings_insights: TRI 3Q 2026 (reported 11/3): revenue $1,833mn versus GS estimate $1,803mn and FactSet consensus $1,825mn, up 10.6% y/y versus 8.7% GS and 10.1% consensus.
TRI 3Q 2026 organic revenue growth 10% y/y (reported) versus GS estimate 8.9%.
TRI 3Q 2026 adjusted EBITDA $651mn (reported) versus GS estimate $623mn and FactSet consensus $648mn. Adjusted EBITDA margin 35.5% versus GS 34.6% and consensus 35.5%.
TRI 3Q 2026 EPS $0.81 (reported) versus GS estimate $0.77 and FactSet consensus $0.83, a slight miss versus consensus.
FY2026 guidance (company): reported revenue growth ~9.5% (from ~8.0%), organic growth 8.5-9.0% (from ~8%), Big 3 organic 9.5-10.0% unchanged, EBITDA margin ~39% (from ~40%+), FCF ~$2.1bn unchanged.
Pre-print FY2026 forecasts: GS reported revenue growth 9.6% (8.9% organic) and EBITDA margin 39.2%. FactSet consensus was reported revenue growth 12.4% and EBITDA margin 39.3%.
4Q 2026 company guidance: organic revenue growth ~8%, EBITDA margin ~42%.
risk_factors: Macro headwinds that could pressure customer budgets.
Slower-than-expected customer adoption of the company's AI-enabled products.
Elevated investment spending that could cause an EBITDA margin shortfall.
